method: Manual live-web evidence run using exact-identity search first, followed by source-level visual/context verification and explicit rights/usability classification. No copyrighted asset was downloaded or treated as automatically reusable merely because it was found.

cases.target: El Mago del Tiempo / Time Wizard (Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG card)

entity_resolution.reason: The official Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG database resolves the target to the exact card Time Wizard (cid=4022), including its card type, stats and historical printings.

exact_discovery.reason: An exact official card record exists; discovery no longer depends on generic stock or public-domain catalogues.

visual_verification.reason: The official record identifies the exact card and a web image result independently shows the Time Wizard trading card artwork, eliminating the generic-magician failure mode.

usability.rights_basis: The official database carries Konami/Studio Dice/Shueisha/TV Tokyo copyright notices and no reusable-media license was identified for the card artwork in this run.
conditions: Keep exact card reference for editorial/research use.
Do not auto-export the card art into the production bundle without an explicit reuse basis or manual clearance.

evidence.label: Official Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG Time Wizard card record
Exact Time Wizard card image result

cases.diagnosis: The original failure was not semantic understanding. Exact discovery succeeds once commercial/reference-only sources are allowed. The remaining bottleneck is reuse rights, so the correct state is reference-only rather than substituting a generic magician.

entity_resolution.reason: Government scientific sources explicitly identify the 1986 Lake Nyos CO2 disaster and documentary investigations immediately after the event.

exact_discovery.reason: USGS exposes an image tied directly to Lake Nyos and describes the 1986 gas release; a USGS field report also documents photographs and movies from the immediate aftermath.

visual_verification.reason: The USGS media record depicts Lake Nyos and explicitly connects the image to the 1986 disaster context; the field report independently confirms documentary photography/movies from August 1986.

usability.rights_basis: The USGS media result labels Sources/Usage as Public Domain.
conditions: Preserve source attribution/metadata even though public-domain reuse does not require a copyright license.

evidence.label: USGS Exploding Lakes in Cameroon image

cases.diagnosis: This case is solvable end-to-end with an exact documentary/government source. Public-domain government media materially improves the acquisition outcome compared with generic scenic-lake search.

entity_resolution.canonical_identity: Plato, represented by a historical bust/sculpture
entity_resolution.reason: The exact visual requirement is a historically appropriate depiction of Plato rather than an anachronistic photograph.

exact_discovery.reason: Wikimedia Commons provides a high-resolution photograph explicitly identified as a bust of Plato at the Capitoline Museum.

visual_verification.reason: The source description and image identify the subject as Plato's bust; the original file is 2448×3264, making it materially usable for video editing.

usability.rights_basis: The Commons file is licensed CC BY-SA 3.0 (with an alternative GFDL license also listed).
conditions: If adapting under CC BY-SA, comply with the share-alike condition or choose an applicable listed license.

cases.diagnosis: Exact identity, strong resolution and explicit reuse terms are all available. The stress case should prefer this type of museum/Commons evidence and reject photorealistic fake depictions.

cases.target: AlphaFold Protein Structure Database interface / 3D viewer

entity_resolution.canonical_identity: AlphaFold Protein Structure Database structure page interface
entity_resolution.reason: EMBL-EBI training and product pages explicitly describe the structure page, Mol* 3D viewer, pLDDT confidence and PAE interface.

exact_discovery.reason: The official EMBL-EBI training page contains interface screenshots and names the precise UI elements requested by the narration.

visual_verification.reason: The training page includes an image of the Summary and Model Confidence tab and describes the interactive 3D viewer and PAE plot; this is direct interface evidence rather than a talking-head substitute.

usability.rights_basis: The EMBL-EBI course states that all materials are licensed CC BY 4.0 except where further licensing details are provided.
conditions: Attribute EMBL-EBI/training material and preserve the CC BY 4.0 notice.
If a specific embedded asset later exposes separate licensing details, those asset-level terms take precedence.

evidence.label: EMBL-EBI Summary and Model Confidence training page

cases.diagnosis: The interface case succeeds when institutional training/documentation sources are searched explicitly. This is much better than relying on title relevance from arbitrary videos.

cases.target: Steve Jobs demonstrating iPhone gestures at Macworld 2007

entity_resolution.canonical_identity: Macworld 2007 original iPhone keynote gesture demonstrations
entity_resolution.reason: The full keynote transcript identifies the exact 2007 event and contains timestamped gesture demonstrations.

exact_discovery.reason: A full 2007 iPhone presentation is available on YouTube, and an independent timestamped transcript maps specific gesture scenes.

visual_verification.reason: The timestamped transcript resolves usable windows instead of assuming the useful shot is in the first 30 seconds.

usability.rights_basis: The located full keynote and derivative clips do not expose a clear reusable-media license in the evidence gathered during this run.
conditions: Keep the exact source and timestamps as scene references.
Do not auto-download/export the footage as cleared media without a separate rights decision.

cases.diagnosis: Scene scouting solves the previous first-30-seconds failure. Exact footage is discoverable and time-addressable, but automatic reuse remains a rights question; the correct machine state is reference-only with precise scene intervals.
